rq2_population: All already measured original Native cut identities; the RQ3 fixed420 membership is an annotation, not an RQ2 admission condition.
rq3_population: Frozen420 unchanged; no extra RQ2 cut may enter RQ3.
identity_requirements: same model content hash and model semantics
same physical accelerator/device and cut boundary identity
matching actual P1/P2 executable artifacts or explicit proven product reuse relation
precision verified from actual runtime/build evidence; unknown precision stays unknown, exact same executable may establish equivalence
matching actual preprocessing, prepared inputs, tensor names/order/dtypes/layouts, output interpretation and completion/postprocessing contract
original runner and source revisions retained; only scientifically compatible complete-task contracts may be compared
measurement_requirements: Preserve established complete-task Generic measurement contract and backend policies: three independent processes, 100 warmups and 1000 fully completed measured tasks each, full postprocessing. Historical reuse requires its existing valid contract evidence.
selection_rule: Choose the latest actually completed, identity- and contract-compatible valid Generic observation by measured completion time; never rank candidate observations by FPS, AP or quality outcome. A newer valid quality FAIL is retained over an older PASS. Unknown ordering or incompatible identity is held with reason.
quality_rule: Use the existing normal quality admission and thresholds unchanged; bind actual prediction runtime, artifact/input/completion identity, dataset/image set, CPU-ONNX model/reference and evaluator policy. Missing evidence is unavailable, never measured accuracy_loss. Report Native and Generic AP and their own reference AP and relative loss separately.
bug_rule: Only demonstrated implementation/assignment errors invalidate evidence. Determine affected cases from code and contract identities, not desired admissions. Reevaluate all actually affected quality; remeasure FPS only when timed runtime/contract changed or valid FPS absent. Preserve original records.
singleton_rule: Keep the established equal-group overall statistic, label groups with fewer than two admitted cuts, additionally report the same statistic restricted to groups with at least two candidates. A singleton zero loss is not evidence of ranking quality.
hardware_rule: Do not interrupt existing b009 or FPS. Use normal physical leases; no concurrent diagnostic/quality/build load on a setup performing FPS. H8/H10 independent.
preserved: RQ1 and existing YOLOv7-b066 case evidence
reviewed_metadata_policy: Missing historical recipe metadata alone does not exclude a pair when exact executable binding, recorded runtime parameters and the retained observed input checks agree. No absent hash is reconstructed; all ordinary identity, timing and quality checks remain active.
